rail.label: Setup steps
rail.privacyNote: Everything you enter here stays on this computer.

welcome.title: Welcome to Applyer
welcome.intro: Glad you're here. Four short steps and your agent can start hunting for jobs with you. Nothing you enter leaves this computer.

find.title: Tell it about you
find.body: Your profile and resume are what the agent reads to judge whether a job is worth your time.

judge.title: Ask it to find jobs
judge.body: It searches, and the matches land on a board here in the app. Nothing is sent anywhere on its own.

submit.title: You press submit
submit.body: The agent can fill an application out for you to review, but the last click is always yours.

welcome.agentNoteTitle: Bring the agent you already use.
welcome.agentNoteBefore: Applyer doesn't ship its own AI. It hands your coding assistant, in the built-in terminal, a set of job-hunting tools over
welcome.mcpTooltip: Model Context Protocol, the standard way a coding agent calls into another app.
welcome.agentNoteAfter: . Claude Code, Codex and anything else that speaks it will do.

storage.title: How should we store your information locally?
storage.intro: Everything stays on this computer either way. This only changes how it's stored on disk.
storage.encryptedDescription: Locked using this computer's built-in secure storage, the same kind of protection your browser uses for saved passwords. Only readable on this device, by your user account.
storage.plaintextDescription: Stored as regular, readable files on this computer. Simpler to back up or inspect yourself, but readable by anyone with access to this computer's files.
storage.unavailable: Not available on this system (no OS keychain detected).
storage.changeLater: You can switch this later in Settings > Storage, and anything already saved gets rewritten to match.

profileForm.title: Your profile
profileForm.intro: This is what the agent uses to judge job matches and fill application forms. Only your name and email are needed to continue.
profileForm.resumeTipBody: Choose "I'll fill this later", add your resume on the next step, and ask your agent to fill this in from it. You can also edit any of it later in Settings.
profileForm.skippedToast: Skipped for now. Your agent can fill this in from your resume, or you can do it in Settings.

documents.title: Your documents
documents.intro: A resume is required. The agent reads it to judge fit, and attaches it when it fills out an application.
documents.formats: PDF, DOCX and TXT files. Applyer reads the text out of them so your agent can too.
documents.emptyProfileTipTitle: This is all your agent will have.
documents.emptyProfileTipBody: You skipped the profile, so add your resume here and ask your agent to fill the profile in from it once setup is done.
documents.readFailed: Could not read {{filename}}. Try selecting it again.

mcp.title: Connect your agent
mcp.intro: One-time setup per agent. Applyer can write the config itself, or you can copy the command into it by hand.
mcp.explainerBefore: Applyer exposes its tools (search, queue, fill) over
mcp.explainerAfter: , so your agent can call into the app the same way it calls any other tool.
mcp.noneDetected: No supported agent CLI was found on this computer. Install Claude Code or Codex, then connect it later from Settings > Agent.
mcp.detectFailed: Could not check which agent CLIs are installed. You can connect one later from Settings > Agent.
mcp.optionalNote: You can skip this and do it later in Settings > Agent. The rest of the app works either way.

ready.title: You're all set.
ready.intro: Applyer is ready. Open the Terminal panel, start your agent, and give it the line below.
ready.firstPromptCaption: Paste this to your agent in the Terminal panel.

prompts.fromResume: Read the resume I uploaded to Applyer, fill in my profile from it, then find matching jobs and queue the good ones.
prompts.roleSearch: Find me {{role}} roles that fit my profile and queue the ones worth applying to.
prompts.genericSearch: Look at my Applyer profile, find jobs that fit it, and queue the ones worth applying to.

ready.finishFailed: Could not finish setup. Please try again.
